items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-26
items.q: Big Boynton wanted me to play drums. He said, I'll show how to read all this stuff. I said, Vic, I don't want to do all that.

ctx.x: Nothing creative about it. Nothing, ah, nah, nah, now we get somewhere, see.

Yeah. The creative part was missing. That's why I didn't want to learn how to read music and learn how to play legitimate drums and then do all that. I could have probably worked in studios out there in California and said, uh, Big Boynton wanted me to play drums. He said, I'll show how to read all this stuff. I said, Vic, I don't want to do all that. I said, I want to play my jazz my way and make people happy my way.
